tasks.task: Discuss the key aspects of the agricultural practices course.

subtasks.text: Introduce the speaker and mention that he teaches agricultural practices at Carinda State High School.
Highlight the unique aspects of their school, having a working agricultural section and access to common land.
Explain that the course covers various areas of food and fibre production.
Mention the practical skills taught in the course, such as machinery operation and fencing construction.
Discuss the unique challenges and real-world problem-solving opportunities in the farm setting.
Emphasize that the course provides fun and exciting opportunities to experience real Australia.
Describe the weekly work outside with cattle at Oxley Creek Common.
Conclude by saying it's a great place to learn.
